objects.description: Boolean type used by HarfBuzz APIs. It is referenced here as the return type of hb_version_atleast but is not defined in this header; it is defined in hb-common.h. Included here only if considered defined in this header, but since it is not, note: this header does not define hb_bool_t.

objects.definition: typedef int hb_bool_t;
objects.description: Boolean type used across HarfBuzz APIs. Nonzero is true, zero is false. Destruction not applicable.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t hb_codepoint_t;
objects.description: Unsigned 32-bit type for Unicode codepoints and glyph IDs. HB_CODEPOINT_INVALID is a special sentinel value.

objects.definition: typedef int32_t hb_position_t;
objects.description: Signed 32-bit coordinate type used for positions and dimensions in font units.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t hb_mask_t;
objects.description: Unsigned 32-bit bitmask type used in shaping APIs.
Union for viewing the same 32-bit storage as various integer widths and signedness. No constructors or ownership semantics.
Union for viewing 32-bit storage as float or various integer representations.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t hb_tag_t;
objects.description: Four-character tag packed into a 32-bit integer, used to identify scripts, tables, features, etc.
Enumeration of text direction: invalid, LTR, RTL, top-to-bottom, bottom-to-top.

objects.definition: typedef const struct hb_language_impl_t *hb_language_t;
objects.description: Opaque pointer to a language object representing a BCP 47 language tag. Implementation is hidden in HarfBuzz.
Key structure used to index user data on various HarfBuzz objects. No public fields; instances are used as stable addresses.

objects.definition: typedef void (*hb_destroy_func_t) (void *user_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for user-data destructors. Called with the user_data to free/cleanup.
Represents a requested OpenType feature application over a cluster range. value 0 disables; non-zero enables or selects an alternate index for some features.
Represents a single variation-axis setting (tag, value).

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t hb_color_t;
objects.description: Packed 8-bit per channel BGRA (as constructed by HB_COLOR) color value. Accessors extract A, R, G, B bytes.
Glyph metrics in font units: bearings and size; height may be negative in coordinate systems that grow up.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_font_t hb_font_t;
objects.description: Opaque font object type. Only a forward declaration is provided here; full definition appears elsewhere.

Enumeration of memory ownership/mutability modes used when creating hb_blob_t objects, indicating how HarfBuzz may access and/or copy the provided data. Guides whether data is duplicated, treated read-only, writable, or readonly-but-mappable-to-writable.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_blob_t hb_blob_t;
objects.description: Opaque blob handle that wraps a chunk of binary data and manages its lifetime and mutability for interchange with HarfBuzz. The struct is forward-declared (no inline definition here); use the API to create, reference, and destroy. Blob data may be read-only or writable depending on memory mode and specific constructor. Sub-blobs are always read-only. Use hb_blob_destroy to release references.
Per-glyph info item used by hb_buffer_t, carrying glyph/codepoint id, cluster mapping, and internal shaping masks/vars.
Bitflags describing per-glyph shaping safety and tatweel-insertion properties. Extractable from hb_glyph_info_t.mask.
Per-glyph positioning result: advances and offsets in font design units, produced after shaping.
Container for text segment properties (direction, script, language) associated with an hb_buffer_t.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_buffer_t hb_buffer_t;
objects.description: Opaque HarfBuzz buffer holding input text and properties before shaping and output glyphs and positions after shaping.
Enumeration of the logical content currently stored in an hb_buffer_t: invalid, Unicode input, or glyph output.

objects.definition:
typedef enum { /*< flags >*/
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_EQUAL			= 0x0000,

  /* Buffers with different content_type cannot be meaningfully compared
   * in any further detail. */
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH	= 0x0001,

  /* For buffers with differing length, the per-glyph comparison is not
   * attempted, though we do still scan reference for dottedcircle / .notdef
   * glyphs. */
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_LENGTH_MISMATCH		= 0x0002,

  /* We want to know if dottedcircle / .notdef glyphs are present in the
   * reference, as we may not care so much about other differences in this
   * case. */
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_NOTDEF_PRESENT		= 0x0004,
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_DOTTED_CIRCLE_PRESENT	= 0x0008,

  /* If the buffers have the same length, we compare them glyph-by-glyph
   * and report which aspect(s) of the glyph info/position are different. */
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_CODEPOINT_MISMATCH	= 0x0010,
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_CLUSTER_MISMATCH		= 0x0020,
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_GLYPH_FLAGS_MISMATCH	= 0x0040,
  HB_BUFFER_DIFF_FLAG_POSITION_MISMATCH		= 0x0080

} hb_buffer_diff_flags_t;
objects.description: Bitflags describing differences found when comparing two buffers.
Function-pointer type for buffer tracing callbacks; returning false skips a shaping step.

Current drawing state used during glyph outline emission. Tracks whether a path is open and the start/current point coordinates. Includes several reserved fields for future expansion. Default initializer macro HB_DRAW_STATE_DEFAULT is provided in this header. Construction is by value; no explicit constructor/destructor functions are provided. Unknown specifics about reserved fields; treat as internal and initialize with the provided macro when starting a draw sequence.

objects.description: Opaque handle for a set of glyph draw callbacks (move_to, line_to, quadratic_to, cubic_to, close_path). Instances are created and managed through the API in this header. The object can be made immutable. Lifetime is managed via reference counting.

Function pointer type for the close-path draw operation callback used by hb_draw_funcs_t. Closes the current contour.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_face_t hb_face_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a font face within HarfBuzz. Represents font tables and metadata; created from a blob, file, or custom table callbacks. Lifetime is managed by reference counting. Becomes immutable after hb_face_make_immutable(). Internal structure is not exposed in this header.

objects.definition: typedef hb_blob_t * (*hb_reference_table_func_t)  (hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t tag, void *user_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type used to reference a table blob for a given face and tag (or HB_TAG_NONE for the face blob). Used by hb_face_create_for_tables(). Returns a newly-referenced blob or NULL on failure. The user_data is later released with the provided destroy callback when passed to hb_face_create_for_tables().

objects.definition:
typedef unsigned int (*hb_get_table_tags_func_t) (const hb_face_t *face,
					  unsigned int  start_offset,

					  hb_tag_t     *table_tags /* OUT */,

The function fills up to *table_count tags into table_tags starting from start_offset, and may use user_data provided via hb_face_set_get_table_tags_func().

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_font_funcs_t hb_font_funcs_t;

Struct holding font-wide vertical metrics in scaled units: ascender, descender, and line gap. Additional reserved fields are present for future use. Used as an output container by font extents callbacks and APIs.
Function-pointer type for virtual methods that return overall font extents (ascender/descender/line gap). The _h_ and _v_ aliases are for horizontal and vertical text directions.

Opaque type representing a font object in HarfBuzz. Provides glyph mapping, metrics, scaling, variation coordinates, synthetic styles, and drawing/painting. The structure is incomplete here; lifetime is managed via reference counting. Constructed from an hb_face_t or as a subfont.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_map_t hb_map_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle to an integer-to-integer hash map in HarfBuzz. The struct is forward-declared only; its layout is private to the library. Use the provided API to create, reference, destroy, and manipulate key/value pairs where both key and value are hb_codepoint_t. HB_MAP_VALUE_INVALID expands to HB_CODEPOINT_INVALID for unset values.
Enum of flags describing properties of an OpenType color palette in a COLR/CPAL-enabled font. Indicates default palette or suitability for light/dark backgrounds.
Struct pairing a glyph ID with a palette color index for a color layer in COLR fonts. A color_index of 0xFFFF indicates use of the foreground color instead of a palette entry.

Deprecated OpenType variation axis record used by older HarfBuzz APIs. Holds the axis tag, name ID, and min/default/max values. Superseded by hb_ot_var_axis_info_t. Fields suggest read-only metadata describing a variable font axis; lifecycle is trivial POD with no dedicated constructor/destructor.

Opaque font object type used by HarfBuzz. Not defined in this header; only referenced. Purpose inferred: represents a font face used for shaping and metrics. Details of layout, lifetime management, and construction are unknown here.
Enumeration of OpenType GDEF glyph classes used to categorize glyphs for layout: unclassified, base glyph, ligature, mark, and component.
Enumeration of OpenType baseline tags identifying different baseline metrics (roman, hanging, ideographic face/embox variants, math). Values are four-character tags encoded via HB_TAG.

Enumeration of OpenType design-variation axis tags used by HarfBuzz style API. Values are four-character tags encoded via HB_TAG and correspond to axes like italic, optical size, slant angle/ratio, width, and weight. Used with hb_style_get_value to query a font’s value for a given style axis. Details such as exact numeric ranges follow OpenType’s registry; private sentinel _HB_STYLE_TAG_MAX_VALUE is not for public use.

objects.definition: typedef struct hb_subset_plan_t hb_subset_plan_t;

  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_PASSTHROUGH_UNRECOGNIZED = 0x00000020u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_NOTDEF_OUTLINE =      0x00000040u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_GLYPH_NAMES =         0x00000080u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_NO_PRUNE_UNICODE_RANGES =  0x00000100u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_NO_LAYOUT_CLOSURE =        0x00000200u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_OPTIMIZE_IUP_DELTAS   =  0x00000400u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_NO_BIDI_CLOSURE       =  0x00000800u,
#ifdef HB_EXPERIMENTAL_API
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_IFTB_REQUIREMENTS     =  0x00001000u,
  HB_SUBSET_FLAGS_RETAIN_NUM_GLYPHS     =  0x00002000u,
#endif
} hb_subset_flags_t;
objects.description: Bitmask enum configuring subsetting behavior (eg, drop hinting, retain original GIDs, desuboutinize CFF, preserve glyph names, disable layout/bidi closure, etc.). Values may include experimental options when HB_EXPERIMENTAL_API is enabled.
Enum identifying which configurable set is being accessed on a subset input (glyph indices, Unicode codepoints, table tags to keep/drop, name IDs, language IDs, layout features/scripts).

Represents a link/edge in the serialization object graph. Each link denotes an offset field inside an object: its size in bytes (width), the byte position of that offset field from the beginning of the owning subtable/object (position), and the index of the target object (objidx) within the object array to be serialized. Used to resolve and patch offsets during table serialization. Destruction/ownership: plain POD; caller manages memory for arrays containing these elements.

Represents a serializable object/subtable with a contiguous data buffer [head, tail). real_links describes actual offset fields within the data that need patching; virtual_links constrains relative ordering by indicating other objects that must follow this one in the final serialized order. The structure is POD; memory management for head/tail buffers and link arrays is external to this header and must be handled by the caller.
Opaque blob type from HarfBuzz representing an immutable byte buffer. Only referenced here as the return type of hb_subset_serialize_or_fail; not defined in this header.
Four-byte tag type from HarfBuzz used to identify OpenType tables. Only referenced as a parameter type; not defined in this header.

functions.name: hb_version
functions.signature: void hb_version(unsigned int *major, unsigned int *minor, unsigned int *micro);
functions.description: Writes the HarfBuzz library version available at runtime into the provided output parameters (major, minor, micro). Typical usage is to query these values to compare against compile-time expectations or to log/report the loaded library version. Details about whether NULL pointers are permitted are not documented in this header; callers should assume the pointers provided must be valid writable locations unless the implementation explicitly documents NULL-tolerance.
requirements: Each of major, minor, and micro should point to a valid, writable unsigned int if provided.
Behavior for passing NULL for any of the pointers is unknown based on this header; avoid passing NULL unless implementation docs confirm it is allowed.
The function performs output only; it does not allocate memory or require prior initialization beyond having writable pointers.

functions.name: hb_version_string
functions.description: Returns a constant, null-terminated C string representing the HarfBuzz library version available at runtime (e.g., "12.2.0"). Intended for display, logging, or diagnostic checks. The returned pointer refers to immutable storage owned by the library.
requirements: Do not modify or free the returned string; it is const and owned by the library.
The returned pointer is expected to remain valid for the lifetime of the process or library, but exact lifetime is not stated in this header.

functions.name: hb_version_atleast
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_version_atleast(unsigned int major, unsigned int minor, unsigned int micro);
functions.description: Returns whether the runtime HarfBuzz library version is greater than or equal to the specified (major, minor, micro) version. Useful for feature gating at runtime when code may run against different library versions.
requirements: Arguments major, minor, and micro are version components and should be non-negative integers; the types are unsigned int, which enforces non-negativity.
Return type hb_bool_t indicates true (non-zero) if the runtime version is at least the provided version; false (zero) otherwise.

functions.name: hb_tag_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_tag_t hb_tag_from_string (const char *str, int len);
functions.description: Parses a 4-character ASCII tag from a string into an hb_tag_t. Intended for constructing OpenType/ISO tags from textual form.
requirements: If len == -1, str must be NUL-terminated (explicitly stated).
str must point to at least len bytes when len >= 0.
If fewer than 4 meaningful characters are provided, behavior/interpretation is unknown (not documented here).

functions.name: hb_tag_to_string
functions.description: Writes the 4-byte textual representation of tag into buf (no terminator implied by this declaration). Intended for producing a 4-character tag from an hb_tag_t.
requirements: buf must be a writable buffer with space for at least 4 bytes (explicitly stated: "buf should have 4 bytes").
No guarantee is stated about NUL-termination; caller must not assume a trailing NUL unless documented elsewhere.

functions.name: hb_direction_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_direction_t hb_direction_from_string (const char *str, int len);
functions.description: Parses a textual direction name (e.g., "ltr", "rtl", "ttb", "btt") into an hb_direction_t.
requirements: If len == -1, str must be NUL-terminated (explicitly stated).
str must point to at least len bytes when len >= 0.

functions.name: hb_direction_to_string
functions.description: Returns a constant string name for a given hb_direction_t.
requirements: direction should ideally be a valid hb_direction_t; behavior for invalid values is not specified here.

functions.name: hb_language_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_language_t hb_language_from_string (const char *str, int len);
functions.description: Converts a BCP 47 language tag in str to an hb_language_t handle. Typically used to set language on buffers or features.
requirements: str should contain a language tag (BCP 47).
Length handling is not documented here; behavior for len == -1 is unknown in this header and should be confirmed in library docs.
When len >= 0, str must reference at least len bytes.

functions.name: hb_language_to_string
functions.description: Returns the canonical string form of an hb_language_t (a BCP 47 tag).
requirements: language should be a valid hb_language_t. Behavior for HB_LANGUAGE_INVALID is not specified here.

functions.name: hb_language_get_default
functions.description: Returns the library’s default language tag for the current environment/context.

functions.name: hb_language_matches
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_language_matches (hb_language_t language, hb_language_t specific);
functions.description: Tests whether specific matches or is compatible with language (useful for language fallback and selection).
requirements: Both language and specific should be valid hb_language_t handles. Matching semantics are not detailed in this header.

functions.name: hb_script_from_iso15924_tag
functions.description: Converts a 4-byte ISO 15924 script tag to an hb_script_t value.

functions.name: hb_script_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_script_t hb_script_from_string (const char *str, int len);
functions.description: Parses a script identifier string (e.g., ISO 15924 code) into an hb_script_t.
requirements: When len >= 0, str must reference at least len bytes.
No explicit statement here about len == -1; behavior is unknown in this header.

functions.name: hb_script_to_iso15924_tag
functions.description: Converts an hb_script_t value to its ISO 15924 4-byte tag.

functions.name: hb_script_get_horizontal_direction
functions.description: Returns the natural horizontal writing direction (LTR or RTL) for the given script.

functions.name: hb_feature_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_feature_from_string (const char *str, int len, hb_feature_t *feature);
functions.description: Parses a feature setting string into an hb_feature_t (e.g., 'kern=0', 'liga=1', with optional start/end ranges). Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: feature must be a valid, writable pointer to hb_feature_t.
When len >= 0, str must reference at least len bytes.
No explicit statement here about len == -1; behavior in this header is unknown.
Caller should check the return value to ensure parsing succeeded.

functions.name: hb_feature_to_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_feature_to_string (hb_feature_t *feature, char *buf, unsigned int size);
functions.description: Serializes an hb_feature_t to a textual form and writes it into buf.
requirements: feature must point to a valid hb_feature_t.
buf must be a writable buffer of at least size bytes.
Caller must provide a sufficiently large buffer; required size and NUL-termination guarantees are not specified here.

functions.name: hb_variation_from_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_variation_from_string (const char *str, int len, hb_variation_t *variation);
functions.description: Parses a variation axis setting (e.g., 'wght=700' or 'wght' with value) into an hb_variation_t. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: variation must be a valid, writable pointer to hb_variation_t.
When len >= 0, str must reference at least len bytes.
No explicit statement here about len == -1; behavior in this header is unknown.
Caller should check the return value to ensure parsing succeeded.

functions.name: hb_variation_to_string
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_variation_to_string (hb_variation_t *variation, char *buf, unsigned int size);
functions.description: Serializes an hb_variation_t to a textual form and writes it into buf.
requirements: variation must point to a valid hb_variation_t.
buf must be a writable buffer of at least size bytes.
Caller must provide a sufficiently large buffer; required size and NUL-termination guarantees are not specified here.

functions.name: hb_color_get_alpha
functions.description: Returns the 8-bit alpha component of the color.

functions.name: hb_color_get_red
functions.description: Returns the 8-bit red component of the color.

functions.name: hb_color_get_green
functions.description: Returns the 8-bit green component of the color.

functions.name: hb_color_get_blue
functions.description: Returns the 8-bit blue component of the color.

functions.name: hb_malloc
functions.description: Allocates size bytes of memory. Thin wrapper around the library’s allocator (semantics similar to malloc).
requirements: size may be zero; behavior and return value for zero size are unspecified here.
Caller must check for NULL on allocation failure.
Memory must be released with hb_free or reallocated with hb_realloc.

functions.name: hb_calloc
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void* hb_calloc (size_t nmemb, size_t size);
functions.description: Allocates and zero-initializes an array of nmemb elements of size bytes each (semantics similar to calloc).
requirements: nmemb and size may be zero; behavior and return value for zero are unspecified here.
Caller must check for NULL on allocation failure.
Memory must be released with hb_free or reallocated with hb_realloc.

functions.name: hb_realloc
functions.description: Changes the size of the memory block pointed to by ptr to size bytes (semantics similar to realloc).
requirements: ptr may be NULL to behave like allocation; semantics beyond that are not specified here.
Caller must check for NULL on allocation/resize failure.
On failure, the original block (if any) remains valid per usual realloc semantics; specific guarantees are not stated here.
Resulting memory should be freed with hb_free or grown/shrunk again with hb_realloc.

functions.name: hb_free
functions.description: Frees memory previously allocated by hb_malloc/hb_calloc/hb_realloc (semantics similar to free).
requirements: ptr may be NULL; behavior for NULL is not specified here (usually a no-op in C, but not guaranteed by this header).
The pointer must have been allocated by the corresponding HarfBuzz allocation functions or be compatible with their allocator.

functions.name: hb_blob_create
functions.signature: hb_blob_t *hb_blob_create(const char *data, unsigned int length, hb_memory_mode_t mode, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Creates an hb_blob_t that wraps a raw memory buffer. The blob manages the buffer according to the specified memory mode; it may copy the data, treat it as read-only, or treat it as writable. Typical usage is to wrap font or binary data for HarfBuzz to consume. The user_data and destroy callback are used by HarfBuzz to track and release the underlying resource when the blob is finalized. Details such as whether NULL data with zero length is allowed or when destroy is called are not documented here and may depend on HarfBuzz conventions.
requirements: data must point to at least length bytes of accessible memory (inferred from parameters).
The HarfBuzz client must never modify memory passed to a blob; if there is any possibility of modification by the client, HB_MEMORY_MODE_DUPLICATE should be used (from hb_memory_mode_t docs).
When using HB_MEMORY_MODE_WRITABLE, the client must have created a dedicated copy of the data solely for HarfBuzz, and HarfBuzz may modify it (from hb_memory_mode_t docs).
HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY_MAY_MAKE_WRITABLE is tricky to use correctly; prefer HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY unless you fully understand the implications (from hb_memory_mode_t docs).

user_data and destroy are application-managed; destroy will be invoked by HarfBuzz to clean up user_data when the blob no longer needs the underlying resource (inferred from common HarfBuzz patterns).
length is the size of the buffer in bytes and should accurately describe the data region (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_create_or_fail
functions.signature: hb_blob_t *hb_blob_create_or_fail(const char *data, unsigned int length, hb_memory_mode_t mode, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Like hb_blob_create but guaranteed to either return a valid blob or NULL on failure (e.g., allocation failure or invalid inputs). Use when you need a failure-reporting constructor instead of a best-effort one.
requirements: Same requirements as hb_blob_create regarding data, length, and memory mode semantics (see hb_memory_mode_t docs).
Caller must check the return value for NULL to detect failure (inferred from “or_fail” naming).

functions.name: hb_blob_create_from_file
functions.description: Creates a blob that contains the contents of the given file. Intended for convenient loading of font or binary data from disk into an hb_blob_t. The exact memory mode used internally is not specified here.
requirements: file_name must point to a valid NUL-terminated path string (inferred from type).
The file must be accessible for reading by the process; errors are handled internally and a blob is returned on best-effort basis (specific failure behavior not documented here).
Caller should not assume writability of the returned data (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_create_from_file_or_fail
functions.description: Creates a blob from a file path and returns NULL on failure. Use when you need explicit failure signaling if the file cannot be read or the blob cannot be created.
requirements: file_name must point to a valid NUL-terminated path string (inferred).
Caller must check for NULL return to detect failure (inferred from “or_fail” naming).
Do not assume the blob’s data is writable (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_create_sub_blob
functions.signature: hb_blob_t *hb_blob_create_sub_blob(hb_blob_t *parent, unsigned int offset, unsigned int length);
functions.description: Creates a new blob that references a subrange of the parent blob’s data. The sub-blob is always created with a READONLY memory mode, even if the parent is writable, to avoid allowing mutation of shared data. Useful for slicing font tables or segments without copying.
requirements: parent must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
offset and length specify a byte range within the parent; offset + length should be within the parent’s length (inferred from typical subrange semantics).
The returned sub-blob will be read-only regardless of the parent’s writability (stated in the comment).

functions.name: hb_blob_copy_writable_or_fail
functions.description: Returns a writable copy of the given blob, or NULL on failure. This is typically used to obtain a buffer that HarfBuzz (or the caller) can safely modify without affecting other users of the original data.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
Caller must check the return value for NULL to detect failure (inferred from “or_fail” naming).
The returned blob’s data may be modified by HarfBuzz; callers should not assume modifications are reflected in the original blob (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_get_empty
functions.description: Returns a singleton empty blob. Useful as a non-NULL placeholder where a blob is required but no data is available. Typically immutable.
requirements: No arguments. The returned blob should be treated as read-only/immutable (inferred from common patterns).

functions.name: hb_blob_reference
functions.description: Increases the reference count of the blob and returns the same blob pointer. Use when retaining shared ownership across components. Behavior for NULL input is not specified here.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t whose reference count can be incremented (inferred).
The caller must eventually balance with hb_blob_destroy when done (inferred from reference-counted APIs).

functions.name: hb_blob_destroy
functions.description: Decreases the reference count of the blob, destroying it and releasing associated resources when the count reaches zero. Commonly used to balance calls to constructors or hb_blob_reference. Behavior for NULL input is not specified here.
requirements: If a reference was obtained (via creation or hb_blob_reference), callers must eventually call hb_blob_destroy to avoid leaks (inferred).
blob must be a blob previously obtained from HarfBuzz APIs (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_blob_set_user_data(hb_blob_t *blob, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary user data with the blob under a given key, with an optional destroy callback to clean it up when the association is replaced or the blob is finalized. If replace is false and a value already exists for the key, the function may fail and return false (exact semantics not documented here).
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
key must identify the user data slot; it should be a stable address usable as a key (inferred from common HarfBuzz patterns).
If replace is false and a value is already set for key, caller must handle a false return (inferred from typical set_user_data semantics).
Caller must check the boolean return value for success/failure (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves user data previously associated with the blob under the given key, or NULL if none is set. Does not modify the blob.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
key must be the same key used to set the user data (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_make_immutable
functions.description: Marks the blob as immutable. Subsequent attempts to access writable data should fail or provide read-only data. Useful to freeze a blob after initialization.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
Once made immutable, callers should not expect to obtain a writable buffer from this blob (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_is_immutable
functions.description: Returns whether the blob has been marked immutable. Use to guard code paths that require writable access.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_get_length
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of the blob’s data. Does not provide access to the data itself.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).

functions.name: hb_blob_get_data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the blob’s read-only data and optionally writes the data length to the provided length pointer. The returned pointer remains valid as long as the blob is alive and not modified by the library. Exact lifetime guarantees and NULL-return conditions are not specified here.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
If length is non-NULL, it must be writable to receive the byte length (inferred).
Caller must treat the returned data as read-only (from const return type and memory mode docs).

functions.name: hb_blob_get_data_writable
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a writable view of the blob’s data and optionally writes the data length. May fail (return NULL) if the blob is immutable or cannot be made writable. Useful when in-place modification is needed.
requirements: blob must be a valid hb_blob_t (inferred).
If length is non-NULL, it must be writable to receive the byte length (inferred).
The blob must not be immutable for writable access to succeed (inferred from function purpose).
Caller must check for NULL return to detect failure (inferred).

functions.name: hb_glyph_info_get_glyph_flags
functions.description: Returns the glyph flags for a given hb_glyph_info_t, indicating properties like unsafe-to-break/concat or safe-to-insert-tatweel. Typically used after shaping to inspect per-glyph flags. Note: in this header it is also defined as a macro that extracts the bits from info->mask.
requirements: info must be a valid, initialized pointer to an hb_glyph_info_t.
The returned flags are limited to HB_GLYPH_FLAG_DEFINED.
Caller should not modify info unless intending to change flags implicitly (flags are derived from internal mask).

functions.name: hb_segment_properties_equal
functions.description: Compares two hb_segment_properties_t for equality (direction, script, language, etc.). Use to determine if two buffers/segments share the same text properties.
requirements: a and b must be valid pointers to initialized hb_segment_properties_t.
Returns true if equivalent, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_segment_properties_hash
functions.description: Computes a hash value for the given segment properties. Useful for using hb_segment_properties_t as keys in hash tables or caches.
requirements: p must be a valid pointer to an initialized hb_segment_properties_t.

functions.name: hb_segment_properties_overlay
functions.description: Overlays src properties onto p (fills unset/invalid fields in p from src). Use to combine explicit properties with guessed/default ones.
requirements: p must be a valid pointer to an hb_segment_properties_t to modify.
src must be a valid pointer to an initialized hb_segment_properties_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_create
functions.description: Creates a new HarfBuzz buffer with default properties. Use as the starting point for adding text and shaping.
requirements: Returns a new reference with refcount 1; must be destroyed with hb_buffer_destroy when no longer needed.

functions.name: hb_buffer_create_similar
functions.description: Creates a new buffer similar to src (copying relevant configuration). Useful to prepare a buffer with the same environment as another.
requirements: src must be a valid hb_buffer_t (inferred).
Returned buffer must be destroyed with hb_buffer_destroy.

functions.name: hb_buffer_reset
functions.description: Resets buffer to its initial state, clearing contents and properties back to defaults.
requirements: buffer must be a valid hb_buffer_t.
All previously returned internal pointers from the buffer (e.g., glyph arrays) become invalid after reset (inferred).

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_empty
functions.description: Returns a singleton empty buffer. Typically used as a no-op buffer placeholder.
requirements: Returned buffer is owned by HarfBuzz; do not destroy it (inferred from common HB patterns).
Do not modify the returned buffer (inferred).

functions.name: hb_buffer_reference
functions.description: Increments and returns a reference to buffer. Use when sharing a buffer across components.
requirements: buffer must be a valid hb_buffer_t.
Each call must be matched by a corresponding hb_buffer_destroy to drop the reference.

functions.name: hb_buffer_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of buffer and frees it when it reaches zero.
requirements: buffer may be NULL (typical in HB, but not stated; if NULL handling is unknown, avoid passing NULL).
Do not use buffer after its refcount reaches zero and it is destroyed.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_buffer_set_user_data (hb_buffer_t *buffer, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary user data with the buffer under key. Optionally supplies a destroy callback to run when the data is replaced or buffer is destroyed.
requirements: buffer must be a valid hb_buffer_t.
key must be a stable, unique hb_user_data_key_t pointer used to identify the slot.
If data is set and a previous value exists: replace must be true to overwrite; otherwise the call fails (behavior inferred from typical HB API).
destroy, if non-NULL, must be safe to call when data is cleared.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves the user data associated with key on buffer, or NULL if not set.
requirements: buffer must be a valid hb_buffer_t.
key must match the key used when setting the data.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_content_type
functions.description: Sets the logical content type of buffer (invalid, unicode, or glyphs). Affects how HarfBuzz interprets the buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
content_type must be one of hb_buffer_content_type_t values.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_content_type
functions.description: Gets the current content type of buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_unicode_funcs
functions.description: Sets the Unicode functions (callbacks/tables) the buffer uses for character properties during shaping.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
unicode_funcs must be a valid hb_unicode_funcs_t or NULL to use defaults (NULL behavior not stated; treat as unknown).

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_unicode_funcs
functions.description: Gets the Unicode functions configured on buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by HarfBuzz; do not destroy (inferred).

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_direction
functions.description: Sets the text direction for shaping (e.g., LTR, RTL, TTB, BTT).
requirements: buffer must be valid.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_direction
functions.description: Gets the buffer's current text direction.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_script
functions.description: Sets the script of the text in buffer (e.g., HB_SCRIPT_LATIN).
requirements: buffer must be valid.
script must be a valid hb_script_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_script
functions.description: Gets the buffer's current script.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_language
functions.description: Sets the language of the text in buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
language must be a valid hb_language_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_language
functions.description: Gets the buffer's current language.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_segment_properties
functions.description: Sets multiple segment properties (direction, script, language) at once on buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
props must point to a valid hb_segment_properties_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_segment_properties
functions.description: Retrieves the current segment properties from buffer into props.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
props must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the properties.

functions.name: hb_buffer_guess_segment_properties
functions.description: Guesses and sets segment properties (direction, script, language) for buffer based on its current contents.
requirements: buffer must be valid.
Buffer should contain input text for guessing to be meaningful (inferred).

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_flags
functions.description: Sets behavioral flags that influence shaping and buffer processing (e.g., BOT/EOT, ignore default ignorables, verification, produce unsafe-to-concat).
requirements: buffer must be valid.
flags must be a combination of hb_buffer_flags_t bits.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_flags
functions.description: Gets the current buffer flags.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_cluster_level
functions.description: Sets the clustering behavior level for shaping (monotone graphemes/characters, characters, graphemes).
requirements: buffer must be valid.
cluster_level must be a valid hb_buffer_cluster_level_t.

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_cluster_level
functions.description: Gets the current cluster level setting of buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: hb_buffer_set_replacement_codepoint
functions.description: Sets the code point used to replace invalid characters when decoding encodings (default U+FFFD).
requirements: buffer must be valid.
replacement should be a valid Unicode scalar value (inferred).

functions.name: hb_buffer_get_replacement_codepoint
functions.description: Gets the current replacement code point for invalid input characters.

reference_table_func must tolerate the special tag HB_TAG_NONE to reference the face blob (may return NULL if unsupported)
user_data is passed to the callback as-is; if provided, destroy will be invoked when the face no longer needs user_data
Destroy the returned face with hb_face_destroy when done

functions.name: hb_face_get_empty
functions.description: Returns a singleton empty hb_face_t. Useful as a non-NULL placeholder that behaves like an empty face.
requirements: The returned face is managed by HarfBuzz; do not destroy it unless documentation explicitly allows
Treat as immutable/empty; setters may have no effect

functions.name: hb_face_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of an hb_face_t and returns the same face pointer.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t obtained from HarfBuzz
The returned face must eventually be balanced with hb_face_destroy to decrement the reference count

functions.name: hb_face_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of an hb_face_t and destroys it when the count reaches zero.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t (or NULL is typically allowed in HarfBuzz APIs; behavior not documented here)
Do not use the face after it has been destroyed
Reference counting must be balanced with hb_face_reference / creators

functions.name: hb_face_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_face_set_user_data(hb_face_t *face, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associates user data with a face under a user-supplied key. Optionally provides a destroy callback. Returns true on success.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
key should uniquely identify the user data slot
If replace is false and a value already exists for key, the call may fail (return false)
If data is set with a destroy callback, the destroy will be called when the data is replaced or the face is destroyed

functions.name: hb_face_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves previously associated user data by key from a face. Returns the stored pointer or NULL if not set.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
key must be the same key used with hb_face_set_user_data

functions.name: hb_face_make_immutable
functions.description: Marks the face immutable, preventing further mutation via setters. Typically used to freeze configuration before sharing the face.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
Once made immutable, do not expect setters to change the face

functions.name: hb_face_is_immutable
functions.description: Returns whether the face has been marked immutable.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t

functions.name: hb_face_reference_table
functions.description: Returns a blob containing the specified font table from the face. The caller owns a reference to the returned blob.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
tag is a 4-byte OpenType table tag identifying the table to fetch
Caller must release the returned blob with hb_blob_destroy when done

functions.name: hb_face_reference_blob
functions.description: Returns a blob of the underlying face data. If a monolithic face blob is not available, HarfBuzz may synthesize one (e.g., using table callbacks if configured).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
Caller must release the returned blob with hb_blob_destroy when done

functions.name: hb_face_set_index
functions.description: Sets the face index associated with this hb_face_t (useful for builder or custom faces).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
If the face is immutable, the setter will not change it
index should correspond to the desired face within a collection

functions.name: hb_face_get_index
functions.description: Returns the face index associated with the hb_face_t.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t

functions.name: hb_face_set_upem
functions.description: Sets units-per-EM (UPM) for the face. Primarily used with builder or custom faces.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
If the face is immutable, the setter will not change it
upem should be a positive integer consistent with font metrics for meaningful results

functions.name: hb_face_get_upem
functions.description: Returns the units-per-EM (UPM) value of the face.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t

functions.name: hb_face_set_glyph_count
functions.description: Sets the declared glyph count of the face. Typically used with builder or custom faces.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
If the face is immutable, the setter will not change it
glyph_count should be the non-negative number of glyphs present for meaningful results

functions.name: hb_face_get_glyph_count
functions.description: Returns the number of glyphs in the face as known to HarfBuzz.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t

functions.name: hb_face_set_get_table_tags_func
functions.signature: void hb_face_set_get_table_tags_func(hb_face_t *face, hb_get_table_tags_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Sets a callback on the face for enumerating table tags (used by hb_face_get_table_tags). The destroy callback will be invoked when user_data is no longer needed.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
func should enumerate table tags based on start_offset/table_count semantics defined for hb_get_table_tags_func_t
user_data is passed to func; if provided, destroy will be called when appropriate
If the face is immutable, setting the function may have no effect

functions.name: hb_face_get_table_tags
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_face_get_table_tags(const hb_face_t *face, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *table_count, hb_tag_t *table_tags);
functions.description: Retrieves table tags from the face using the configured get_table_tags callback. Returns the total number of tables, or zero if listing is not possible. Writes up to table_count input value tags into table_tags, starting at start_offset.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
table_count must point to an input/output integer: input is the maximum tags to write; output is the number of tags actually written (may be zero)
If table_tags is non-NULL, it must have capacity for the input value of *table_count entries
start_offset is the index of the first table tag to retrieve; callers should ensure it is within the total count to receive any tags

functions.name: hb_face_collect_unicodes
functions.description: Collects all Unicode code points supported by the face (nominally encodable by cmap) and adds them to the output set.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
out must be a valid, writable hb_set_t
The function adds to the set; callers should clear it first if they need only the collected values

functions.name: hb_face_collect_nominal_glyph_mapping
functions.description: Collects the nominal Unicode-to-glyph mapping for the face, writing codepoint→glyph mappings into mapping. If provided, limits to the code points in unicodes.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
mapping must be a valid, writable hb_map_t to receive entries
If unicodes is non-NULL, it should be a valid hb_set_t specifying which code points to include

functions.name: hb_face_collect_variation_selectors
functions.description: Collects all Unicode variation selector code points supported by the face and adds them to out.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
out must be a valid, writable hb_set_t

functions.name: hb_face_collect_variation_unicodes
functions.description: Collects Unicode code points that have glyph variants under the given variation selector and adds them to out.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t
variation_selector must be a Unicode code point representing a variation selector for meaningful results
out must be a valid, writable hb_set_t

functions.name: hb_face_builder_create
functions.description: Creates a builder hb_face_t to which tables can be added programmatically before use. Useful for constructing synthetic faces.
requirements: Destroy the returned face with hb_face_destroy when done
The builder face is mutable until made immutable

functions.name: hb_face_builder_add_table
functions.description: Adds a table blob to a builder face under the specified tag. Returns true on success.
requirements: face must be a builder hb_face_t created by hb_face_builder_create and not yet immutable
tag is the 4-byte OpenType table tag for the table being added
blob must be a valid hb_blob_t containing the table data; ownership is not documented here (treat as retained elsewhere unless documented)

functions.name: hb_face_builder_sort_tables
functions.description: Requests sorting/ordering of tables in the builder face, optionally guided by the provided tag order. Exact sorting semantics are not documented here.
requirements: face must be a builder hb_face_t and not immutable
tags, if non-NULL, should point to an array of hb_tag_t specifying desired order; termination/length is not documented here (unknown)

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_create
functions.description: Allocate and return a new hb_font_funcs_t object representing a set of virtual font callbacks. Callers can set specific callbacks and user data, then use with hb_font_set_funcs().
requirements: Returns a newly created object; caller should destroy it with hb_font_funcs_destroy() when no longer needed.
Object can be made immutable via hb_font_funcs_make_immutable(); after that, setters must not be used.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_get_empty
functions.description: Return a singleton empty hb_font_funcs_t with default callbacks. Typically used when no custom functions are needed.
requirements: The returned object is a singleton and is typically immutable (library pattern); do not attempt to modify it.
Do not destroy the returned object.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_reference
functions.description: Increase the reference count of an hb_font_funcs_t and return the same pointer.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t pointer.
Each successful call must be balanced with a corresponding hb_font_funcs_destroy().

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_destroy
functions.description: Decrease the reference count of an hb_font_funcs_t and destroy it when the count reaches zero.
requirements: ffuncs may be NULL-safe per typical HarfBuzz pattern (unknown if explicitly allowed); if non-NULL it must be a valid object from HarfBuzz.
Must be called exactly once per matching reference to avoid leaks.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_funcs_set_user_data (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associate an arbitrary user data pointer with an hb_font_funcs_t under a key, optionally replacing an existing value.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t.
key must be a valid hb_user_data_key_t pointer identifying the entry.
If replace is false and a value already exists for key, the function will fail (return value indicates success).
If provided, destroy will be called when the data is removed or replaced.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieve a user data pointer previously set on an hb_font_funcs_t for a given key.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t.
key must be the same key used to set the data.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_make_immutable
functions.description: Make an hb_font_funcs_t immutable so its callbacks and user data can no longer be changed.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t.
After calling, do not call any setter on ffuncs.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_is_immutable
functions.description: Query whether an hb_font_funcs_t has been marked immutable.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_font_h_extents_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_font_h_extents_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_font_h_extents_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the horizontal font-extents callback on an hb_font_funcs_t.
requirements: ffuncs must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t and not immutable.
func is the callback; it will receive user_data when invoked.
destroy (if non-NULL) will be called to free user_data when no longer needed.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_font_v_extents_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_font_v_extents_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_font_v_extents_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the vertical font-extents callback on an hb_font_funcs_t.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must follow hb_font_get_font_v_extents_func_t semantics.
destroy (if provided) is called for user_data lifecycle.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_nominal_glyph_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_nominal_glyph_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_nominal_glyph_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the nominal Unicode-to-glyph mapping callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write a glyph id to the output parameter and return true on success.
destroy (if provided) manages user_data lifecycle.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_nominal_glyphs_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_nominal_glyphs_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_nominal_glyphs_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the batched Unicode-to-glyphs mapping callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must process up to count code points using stride parameters and return number processed.
Caller passes strided arrays: unicode_stride and glyph_stride are in units of bytes.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_variation_glyph_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_variation_glyph_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_variation_glyph_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the variation-selector mapping callback (Unicode + VS to glyph).
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write glyph id and return true on success.
destroy handles user_data if provided.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_advance_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_advance_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_h_advance_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the horizontal glyph advance callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func returns hb_position_t advance for a glyph.
destroy manages user_data if provided.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_advance_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_advance_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_v_advance_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the vertical glyph advance callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func returns hb_position_t advance for a glyph.
destroy manages user_data if provided.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_advances_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_advances_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_h_advances_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the batched horizontal advances callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must fill advances for count glyphs using glyph_stride and advance_stride (byte strides).

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_advances_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_advances_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_v_advances_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the batched vertical advances callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must fill advances for count glyphs using the provided strides.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_origin_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_origin_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_h_origin_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the horizontal glyph origin callback (x,y in scaled units).
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write x and y origins and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_origin_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_origin_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_v_origin_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the vertical glyph origin callback (x,y in scaled units).
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write x and y origins and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_origins_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_origins_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_h_origins_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the batched horizontal glyph origins callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must fill per-glyph x and y origins using provided strides and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_origins_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_v_origins_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_v_origins_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the batched vertical glyph origins callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must fill per-glyph x and y origins using provided strides and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_kerning_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_h_kerning_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_h_kerning_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the horizontal kerning callback for a pair of glyphs.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func returns hb_position_t kerning value for (left,right) glyphs.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_extents_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_extents_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_extents_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the glyph extents callback (bbox in scaled units).
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write hb_glyph_extents_t and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_contour_point_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_contour_point_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_contour_point_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the glyph contour point callback (x,y of a point index).
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write x and y and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_name_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_name_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_name_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the glyph-id to name callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write a name string up to size bytes and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_from_name_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_glyph_from_name_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_get_glyph_from_name_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the name-to-glyph-id callback.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must write a glyph id and return true on success.
len of -1 means name is NUL-terminated.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_draw_glyph_or_fail_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_draw_glyph_or_fail_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_draw_glyph_or_fail_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the outline drawing callback for a glyph, with success/failure return.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must call draw_funcs with draw_data to emit the glyph and return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_funcs_set_paint_glyph_or_fail_func
functions.signature: void hb_font_funcs_set_paint_glyph_or_fail_func (hb_font_funcs_t *ffuncs, hb_font_paint_glyph_or_fail_func_t func, void *user_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install the color glyph painting callback, with success/failure return.
requirements: ffuncs must be valid and not immutable.
func must use paint_funcs/paint_data, palette_index, and foreground; return true on success.

functions.name: hb_font_get_h_extents
functions.description: Get horizontal font extents (ascender, descender, line_gap) in scaled units.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
extents must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise (implied by underlying func).

functions.name: hb_font_get_v_extents
functions.description: Get vertical font extents in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
extents must be a valid output pointer.

functions.name: hb_font_get_nominal_glyph
functions.description: Map a Unicode code point to its nominal glyph ID.
requirements: font must be valid.
glyph must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true if mapping exists, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_variation_glyph
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_variation_glyph (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t unicode, hb_codepoint_t variation_selector, hb_codepoint_t *glyph);
functions.description: Map a Unicode code point plus variation selector to a glyph ID.
requirements: font must be valid.
glyph must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true if mapping exists, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_nominal_glyphs
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_font_get_nominal_glyphs (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_unicode, unsigned int unicode_stride, hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned int glyph_stride);
functions.description: Map a sequence of Unicode code points to glyph IDs using strided arrays.
requirements: font must be valid.
first_unicode must point to at least count code points with unicode_stride byte stride.
first_glyph must point to storage for at least count glyph ids with glyph_stride byte stride.
Returns number of code points processed.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_h_advance
functions.description: Get horizontal advance of a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_v_advance
functions.description: Get vertical advance of a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_h_advances
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_h_advances (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned glyph_stride, hb_position_t *first_advance, unsigned advance_stride);
functions.description: Get horizontal advances for a sequence of glyphs using strided arrays.
requirements: font must be valid.
first_glyph must point to at least count glyph ids with glyph_stride byte stride.
first_advance must point to storage for at least count advances with advance_stride byte stride.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_v_advances
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_v_advances (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned glyph_stride, hb_position_t *first_advance, unsigned advance_stride);
functions.description: Get vertical advances for a sequence of glyphs using strided arrays.
requirements: font must be valid.
first_glyph and first_advance must reference buffers sized for count entries using provided byte strides.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_h_origin
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_h_origin (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get the horizontal text origin (x,y) for a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_v_origin
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_v_origin (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get the vertical text origin (x,y) for a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_h_origins
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_h_origins (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned glyph_stride, hb_position_t *first_x, unsigned x_stride, hb_position_t *first_y, unsigned y_stride);
functions.description: Get horizontal origins for multiple glyphs using strided arrays; returns true on success.
requirements: font must be valid.
first_glyph must point to at least count glyph ids with glyph_stride byte stride.
first_x and first_y must have storage for count entries with x_stride and y_stride byte strides.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_v_origins
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_v_origins (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned glyph_stride, hb_position_t *first_x, unsigned x_stride, hb_position_t *first_y, unsigned y_stride);
functions.description: Get vertical origins for multiple glyphs using strided arrays; returns true on success.
requirements: font must be valid.
Strided buffer requirements match the horizontal variant.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_h_kerning
functions.signature: hb_position_t hb_font_get_glyph_h_kerning (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t left_glyph, hb_codepoint_t right_glyph);
functions.description: Get horizontal kerning adjustment between two glyphs.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_extents
functions.description: Get bounding box extents for a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
extents must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_contour_point
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_contour_point (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned int point_index, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get the position (x,y) of a contour point within a glyph in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_name
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_name (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, char *name, unsigned int size);
functions.description: Get the name string for a glyph id.
requirements: font must be valid.
name must point to a buffer of at least size bytes.
Returns true if a name was provided, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_from_name
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_from_name (hb_font_t *font, const char *name, int len, hb_codepoint_t *glyph);
functions.description: Resolve a glyph id from a glyph name string.
requirements: font must be valid.
name must be a valid string; len of -1 means NUL-terminated.
glyph must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true on success, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_draw_glyph_or_fail
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_draw_glyph_or_fail (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_draw_funcs_t *dfuncs, void *draw_data);
functions.description: Draw an outline glyph by invoking draw functions; returns success/failure.
requirements: font must be valid.
dfuncs must be a valid hb_draw_funcs_t defining callbacks.
draw_data is passed through to the draw callbacks.

functions.name: hb_font_paint_glyph_or_fail
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_paint_glyph_or_fail (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_paint_funcs_t *pfuncs, void *paint_data, unsigned int palette_index, hb_color_t foreground);
functions.description: Paint a color glyph via paint functions; returns success/failure.
requirements: font must be valid.
pfuncs must be a valid hb_paint_funcs_t.
paint_data is passed to paint callbacks.
palette_index selects the color palette; foreground provides a color.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t unicode, hb_codepoint_t variation_selector, hb_codepoint_t *glyph);
functions.description: High-level glyph mapping: if variation_selector is 0 use nominal mapping, otherwise use variation mapping.
requirements: font must be valid.
glyph must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true on success, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_extents_for_direction
functions.description: Get font extents for a specified text direction, filling extents in scaled units.
requirements: font must be valid.
extents must be a valid output pointer.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_advance_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_advance_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get the advance vector for a glyph in a given direction; returns components via x and y.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_advances_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_advances_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_direction_t direction, unsigned int count, const hb_codepoint_t *first_glyph, unsigned glyph_stride, hb_position_t *first_advance, unsigned advance_stride);
functions.description: Get advances for multiple glyphs for a given direction using strided arrays.
requirements: font must be valid.
first_glyph must point to at least count glyph ids with glyph_stride byte stride.
first_advance must have storage for count advances with advance_stride byte stride.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_origin_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_origin_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get the origin (x,y) for a glyph in a given direction.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_add_glyph_origin_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_add_glyph_origin_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Adjust the provided (x,y) by adding the glyph origin for the specified direction.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid in/out pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_subtract_glyph_origin_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_subtract_glyph_origin_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Adjust the provided (x,y) by subtracting the glyph origin for the specified direction.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid in/out pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_kerning_for_direction
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_glyph_kerning_for_direction (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t first_glyph, hb_codepoint_t second_glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get kerning adjustment for a glyph pair in a given direction, returning vector components via x and y.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_extents_for_origin
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_extents_for_origin (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, hb_glyph_extents_t *extents);
functions.description: Get glyph extents appropriate to a given origin/direction.
requirements: font must be valid.
extents must be a valid output pointer.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_get_glyph_contour_point_for_origin
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_get_glyph_contour_point_for_origin (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned int point_index, hb_direction_t direction, hb_position_t *x, hb_position_t *y);
functions.description: Get a contour point position for a glyph with respect to a given origin/direction.
requirements: font must be valid.
x and y must be valid output pointers.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
Returns true if data found, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_glyph_to_string
functions.signature: void hb_font_glyph_to_string (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, char *s, unsigned int size);
functions.description: Convert a glyph id to a string name; generates gidDDD if unnamed.
requirements: font must be valid.
s must point to a buffer of at least size bytes.

functions.name: hb_font_glyph_from_string
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_glyph_from_string (hb_font_t *font, const char *s, int len, hb_codepoint_t *glyph);
functions.description: Parse a glyph from a string; understands forms like gidDDD and uniUUUU.
requirements: font must be valid.
s must be a valid string; len of -1 means NUL-terminated.
glyph must be a valid output pointer.
Returns true on success, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_draw_glyph
functions.signature: void hb_font_draw_glyph (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_draw_funcs_t *dfuncs, void *draw_data);
functions.description: Older alias that draws an outline glyph via draw funcs; does not report success/failure.
requirements: font must be valid.
dfuncs must be a valid hb_draw_funcs_t.
draw_data is passed to callbacks.

functions.name: hb_font_paint_glyph
functions.signature: void hb_font_paint_glyph (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_paint_funcs_t *pfuncs, void *paint_data, unsigned int palette_index, hb_color_t foreground);
functions.description: Paint a color glyph; if that fails internally, draws the outline fallback. No return value.
requirements: font must be valid.
pfuncs must be a valid hb_paint_funcs_t.
paint_data is passed to callbacks.
palette_index selects a palette; foreground specifies a color.

functions.name: hb_font_create
functions.description: Create a new hb_font_t for a given hb_face_t.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t (inferred from usage).
Caller must destroy the returned font with hb_font_destroy() when done.

functions.name: hb_font_create_sub_font
functions.description: Create a sub-font that inherits settings from a parent hb_font_t.
requirements: parent must be a valid hb_font_t.
Caller must destroy the returned font with hb_font_destroy() when done.

functions.name: hb_font_get_empty
functions.description: Return a singleton empty hb_font_t used as a no-op font.
requirements: The returned object is a singleton; do not destroy or modify it.

functions.name: hb_font_reference
functions.description: Increase reference count of an hb_font_t and return the same pointer.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
Balance with hb_font_destroy() calls.

functions.name: hb_font_destroy
functions.description: Decrease reference count of an hb_font_t and destroy when it reaches zero.
requirements: font should be a valid hb_font_t or NULL-safe per library pattern (unknown explicitly).
Call once per reference to avoid leaks or premature free.

functions.name: hb_font_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_font_set_user_data (hb_font_t *font, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associate user data with an hb_font_t under the given key, optionally replacing an existing value.
requirements: font must be valid.
key must be a valid hb_user_data_key_t pointer.
If replace is false and a value exists, the call fails (return indicates success).
destroy (if provided) is called when data is removed or replaced.

functions.name: hb_font_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieve user data previously set on an hb_font_t for the provided key.
requirements: font must be valid.
key must match the one used when setting the data.

functions.name: hb_font_make_immutable
functions.description: Mark an hb_font_t as immutable to prevent further mutation of its settings.
requirements: font must be valid.
After calling, do not call mutating functions on the font.

functions.name: hb_font_is_immutable
functions.description: Query whether the hb_font_t has been made immutable.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_serial
functions.description: Get a serial value for the font, typically incremented when the font changes (inferred from name).
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_changed
functions.description: Notify the font that its properties have changed so dependent caches can be invalidated (inferred from name).
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_set_parent
functions.description: Set the parent font from which settings can be inherited.
requirements: font must be valid.
parent must be a valid hb_font_t or possibly NULL (unknown).
Font must not be immutable when changing parent.

functions.name: hb_font_get_parent
functions.description: Get the parent font of the given font.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_set_face
functions.description: Associate a new hb_face_t with the font.
requirements: font must be valid.
face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Font must not be immutable when changing face.

functions.name: hb_font_get_face
functions.description: Get the hb_face_t associated with the font.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_set_funcs
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_funcs (hb_font_t *font, hb_font_funcs_t *klass, void *font_data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Install a callbacks vtable (hb_font_funcs_t) on a font along with font-specific data and a destroy notifier.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
klass must be a valid hb_font_funcs_t (often immutable).
font_data is passed to callbacks; destroy (if provided) is called when replaced or font is destroyed.

functions.name: hb_font_set_funcs_data
functions.description: Replace only the font_data and destroy notifier used by the currently set font funcs. Be very careful using this.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
Intended for advanced usage; the lifecycle of previous data is managed via the provided destroy callback.

functions.name: hb_font_set_funcs_using
functions.description: Set font funcs by name (select an implementation by string identifier).
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
name must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
Returns true on success, false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_font_list_funcs
functions.description: List available named font function implementations.
