requirements: Returns a pointer to an array of string pointers (lifetime managed by the library; do not free).

functions.name: hb_font_set_scale
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_scale (hb_font_t *font, int x_scale, int y_scale);
functions.description: Set the font scaling factors for x and y directions (scaled units).
requirements: font must be valid.
A zero value for a direction disables hinting in that direction (as documented near set_ppem; general note applies to hinting, not explicitly to scale).

functions.name: hb_font_get_scale
functions.description: Get the font scaling factors for x and y directions.
requirements: font must be valid.
x_scale and y_scale must be valid output pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: hb_font_set_ppem
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_ppem (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int x_ppem, unsigned int y_ppem);
functions.description: Set pixels-per-EM in x and y. A zero value means no hinting in that direction.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_ppem
functions.signature: void hb_font_get_ppem (hb_font_t *font, unsigned int *x_ppem, unsigned int *y_ppem);
functions.description: Get pixels-per-EM in x and y.
requirements: font must be valid.
x_ppem and y_ppem must be valid output pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: hb_font_set_ptem
functions.description: Set point size per EM. Used for optical sizing in CoreText. A value of zero means not set.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_get_ptem
functions.description: Get point size per EM previously set, or zero if not set.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_is_synthetic
functions.description: Report whether the font has synthetic styling applied (inferred from name).
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_set_synthetic_bold
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_synthetic_bold (hb_font_t *font, float x_embolden, float y_embolden, hb_bool_t in_place);
functions.description: Apply synthetic bold emboldening parameters to the font.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
in_place selects whether emboldening is applied in-place (meaning depends on backend; details unknown).

functions.name: hb_font_get_synthetic_bold
functions.description: Get current synthetic bold parameters.
requirements: font must be valid.
x_embolden, y_embolden, and in_place must be valid output pointers if non-NULL.

functions.name: hb_font_set_synthetic_slant
functions.description: Apply synthetic slant to the font (italicization).
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.

functions.name: hb_font_get_synthetic_slant
functions.description: Get current synthetic slant value.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_font_set_variations
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_variations (hb_font_t *font, const hb_variation_t *variations, unsigned int variations_length);
functions.description: Set multiple variable-font axis values (design coordinates) at once.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
variations points to an array of length variations_length (may be 0 to clear variations).

functions.name: hb_font_set_variation
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_variation (hb_font_t *font, hb_tag_t tag, float value);
functions.description: Set a single variable-font axis value identified by tag to value.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.

functions.name: hb_font_set_var_coords_design
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_var_coords_design (hb_font_t *font, const float *coords, unsigned int coords_length);
functions.description: Set design-space variation coordinates as an array of floats.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
coords must point to coords_length floats.

functions.name: hb_font_get_var_coords_design
functions.description: Get current design-space variation coordinates and their count.
requirements: font must be valid.
length must be a valid output pointer if non-NULL.
Returned pointer is managed by the library; do not free.

functions.name: hb_font_set_var_coords_normalized
functions.signature: void hb_font_set_var_coords_normalized (hb_font_t *font, const int *coords, unsigned int coords_length);
functions.description: Set normalized (2.14) variation coordinates as an array of ints.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.
coords must point to coords_length integers in 2.14 normalized format.

functions.name: hb_font_get_var_coords_normalized
functions.description: Get current normalized (2.14) variation coordinates and their count.
requirements: font must be valid.
length must be a valid output pointer if non-NULL.
Returned pointer is managed by the library; do not free.

functions.name: hb_font_set_var_named_instance
functions.description: Select a named instance by index for a variable font. Use HB_FONT_NO_VAR_NAMED_INSTANCE to clear.
requirements: font must be valid and not immutable.

functions.name: hb_font_get_var_named_instance
functions.description: Get the currently selected named instance index, or HB_FONT_NO_VAR_NAMED_INSTANCE if none.
requirements: font must be valid.

functions.name: hb_map_create
functions.description: Creates and returns a new, empty hb_map_t (integer-to-integer hash map) instance. Use hb_map_destroy to free it when done.
requirements: Caller must destroy the returned map with hb_map_destroy when no longer needed to avoid memory leaks.
Returned pointer is non-null on success; if allocation fails, subsequent hb_map_allocation_successful(map) may report failure.

functions.name: hb_map_get_empty
functions.description: Returns a pointer to an empty hb_map_t. Typically used as a shared, empty map instance when no entries are needed.
requirements: The returned map must be treated as a valid hb_map_t pointer.
Whether the returned map is mutable or shared is unspecified in this header; do not assume it can be modified (unknown).
Do not free this with standard free(); use hb_map_destroy if ownership/usage rules permit (unknown per header).

functions.name: hb_map_reference
functions.description: Increases the reference count of the given map and returns the same map pointer. Use to share ownership across components.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t obtained from HarfBuzz (e.g., via hb_map_create or hb_map_get_empty).
Each successful call should be later balanced with hb_map_destroy to release the reference.

functions.name: hb_map_destroy
functions.description: Decreases the reference count of the map and destroys it when the count reaches zero. After this call, the map pointer must not be used.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t or NULL (behavior for NULL not specified here; unknown).
Do not use the map after destroying it.

functions.name: hb_map_set_user_data
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_map_set_user_data(hb_map_t *map, hb_user_data_key_t *key, void *data, hb_destroy_func_t destroy, hb_bool_t replace);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary user data with the map under the provided key. Optionally installs a destroy callback to be called when the data is replaced or the map is destroyed. Returns true on success.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key must identify the user-data slot; it should be a stable address for the lifetime of the association (inferred from HarfBuzz user-data pattern).
If replace is false and a value is already set for key, the function may fail and return false (inferred).
If destroy is provided, it may be called to release data when the association is replaced or the map is destroyed (inferred).
Caller is responsible for ensuring data remains valid for the lifetime of the association or until destroy is called.

functions.name: hb_map_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves the user data pointer associated with the given key on this map, or NULL if none is set.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key must be the same key used to set the user data.

functions.name: hb_map_allocation_successful
functions.description: Reports whether any allocation failure has occurred for this map. Returns false if an allocation failed previously; true otherwise.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.

functions.name: hb_map_copy
functions.description: Creates and returns a (deep) copy of the given map, duplicating its key-value entries.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
Caller must destroy the returned map with hb_map_destroy when done.

functions.name: hb_map_clear
functions.description: Removes all key-value pairs from the map, leaving it empty.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.

functions.name: hb_map_is_empty
functions.description: Returns true if the map contains no key-value pairs; false otherwise.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.

functions.name: hb_map_get_population
functions.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs currently stored in the map.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.

functions.name: hb_map_is_equal
functions.description: Returns true if map and other contain the same set of key-value pairs; false otherwise.
requirements: map and other must be valid hb_map_t instances.

functions.name: hb_map_hash
functions.description: Computes and returns a hash value for the contents of the map, suitable for use in hash tables alongside hb_map_is_equal.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.

functions.name: hb_map_set
functions.signature: void hb_map_set(hb_map_t *map, hb_codepoint_t key, hb_codepoint_t value);
functions.description: Inserts or updates the mapping from key to value in the map. If key already exists, its value is updated.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key and value must be valid hb_codepoint_t values (unsigned code points as defined by HarfBuzz).

functions.name: hb_map_get
functions.description: Returns the value associated with key, or HB_MAP_VALUE_INVALID if the key is not present. HB_MAP_VALUE_INVALID equals HB_CODEPOINT_INVALID.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key must be a valid hb_codepoint_t.

functions.name: hb_map_del
functions.description: Removes the mapping for key from the map if present. No effect if the key does not exist.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key must be a valid hb_codepoint_t.

functions.name: hb_map_has
functions.description: Returns true if the map contains key; false otherwise.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
key must be a valid hb_codepoint_t.

functions.name: hb_map_update
functions.description: Merges entries from other into map. Keys present in other are applied to map (exact conflict/overwrite behavior not specified here; unknown).
requirements: map and other must be valid hb_map_t instances.

functions.name: hb_map_next
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_map_next(const hb_map_t *map, int *idx, hb_codepoint_t *key, hb_codepoint_t *value);
functions.description: Iterates over entries in the map. On each call, advances idx and writes the next key and value, returning true while entries remain. Pass -1 in idx to start iteration.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
idx must be a valid pointer to an integer; initialize *idx to -1 before the first call.
key and value must be valid pointers if the corresponding outputs are desired (passing NULL is not specified here; unknown).
Call repeatedly until the function returns false to finish iteration.

functions.name: hb_map_keys
functions.description: Extracts all keys from map into the provided hb_set_t collection.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
keys must be a valid hb_set_t pointer. Whether the set is cleared before population or appended to is not specified here (unknown).

functions.name: hb_map_values
functions.description: Extracts all values from map into the provided hb_set_t collection.
requirements: map must be a valid hb_map_t.
values must be a valid hb_set_t pointer. Whether the set is cleared before population or appended to is not specified here (unknown).

functions.name: hb_ot_color_has_palettes
functions.description: Returns whether the face provides color palettes (CPAL table). Use this to gate palette-related queries.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t pointer created from a font.
Returns true if the face contains color palette data; false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_palette_get_count
functions.description: Returns the number of color palettes available in the face (CPAL palette count).
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t pointer.
If the face has no palettes, returns 0.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_palette_get_name_id
functions.description: Returns the name ID (OpenType NAME table ID) associated with the specified palette, or a special value if none. Use hb_ot_name_get_utf8/etc. to resolve the name.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
palette_index must be less than hb_ot_color_palette_get_count(face).
If the palette has no name, the returned name ID may be a reserved/unknown value; callers should handle that.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_palette_color_get_name_id
functions.description: Returns the name ID for the specified palette color entry (entry name shared across palettes), or a special value if none.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.

color_index must be within the number of palette color entries (palette entry count). This count can be obtained via hb_ot_color_palette_get_colors(face, any_palette, 0, &count, NULL) where count receives the total entries.
Callers must handle the case where no name is available for a color entry.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_palette_get_flags
functions.description: Returns flags describing the palette’s intended usage (eg. usable on light/dark backgrounds).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
palette_index must be less than hb_ot_color_palette_get_count(face).

functions.name: hb_ot_color_palette_get_colors
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_color_palette_get_colors (hb_face_t *face, unsigned int palette_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *color_count, hb_color_t *colors);
functions.description: Retrieves color values from the specified palette into the provided buffer. Use NULL to query counts. Colors are returned as hb_color_t entries starting at start_offset.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
palette_index must be less than hb_ot_color_palette_get_count(face).
start_offset must be less than or equal to the total number of colors in the palette.
If colors is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer with capacity for at least *color_count entries on input; on return, *color_count is updated with the number of colors written.
If color_count is non-NULL and colors is NULL, *color_count is updated with the total number of colors available (from start_offset to end), and the return value indicates how many would be written.
Both color_count and colors may be NULL; in that case, the function returns the total number of colors available from start_offset.
The return value is the number of colors actually written to colors (0 if colors is NULL), or the number available when querying.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_has_layers
functions.description: Returns whether the face provides color glyph layer information (COLR/CPAL layering).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Returns true if layered color glyph data is present; false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_glyph_get_layers
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_color_glyph_get_layers (hb_face_t *face, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *layer_count, hb_ot_color_layer_t *layers);
functions.description: Retrieves the color layers for a given base glyph. Each layer specifies a glyph ID and a palette color index (0xFFFF means use foreground color). Use NULL to query counts.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID in the face.
start_offset must be less than or equal to the number of layers for the glyph.
If layers is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer with capacity for at least *layer_count entries on input; on return, *layer_count is updated with the number of layers written.
If layer_count is non-NULL and layers is NULL, *layer_count is updated with the total number of layers available (from start_offset to end), and the return value indicates how many would be written.
Both layer_count and layers may be NULL; in that case, the function returns the total number of layers available from start_offset.
The return value is the number of layers actually written to layers (0 if layers is NULL), or the number available when querying.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_has_paint
functions.description: Returns whether the face contains COLRv1 paint graph structures (advanced color glyph paints).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Returns true if COLRv1 paint data is present; false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_glyph_has_paint
functions.description: Returns whether the specified glyph has COLRv1 paint data in the face.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID in the face.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_has_svg
functions.description: Returns whether the face contains SVG glyph documents (SVG table).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Returns true if the SVG table is present with glyph content; false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_glyph_reference_svg
functions.description: Returns an hb_blob_t containing the raw SVG document for the specified glyph, or NULL if none. The caller owns a reference to the blob and should destroy it when done.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID in the face.
The returned blob may be NULL if the glyph has no SVG; callers must check for NULL before use.
The returned blob must be released with hb_blob_destroy() when no longer needed.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_has_png
functions.description: Returns whether the face contains embedded bitmap color glyphs in CBDT/CBLC or sbix (PNG data).
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Returns true if the face has PNG-backed color glyphs; false otherwise.

functions.name: hb_ot_color_glyph_reference_png
functions.description: Returns an hb_blob_t containing the PNG image for the specified glyph from CBDT/sbix data, or NULL if none. The caller owns a reference and must destroy it when done. The selected strike/size depends on the hb_font_t settings (e.g. ppem).
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t associated with the target face; set font size/ppem as desired to select an appropriate strike.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID in the font/face.
The returned blob may be NULL if the glyph has no PNG image; callers must check for NULL before use.
The returned blob must be released with hb_blob_destroy() when no longer needed.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_choose_script
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_table_choose_script(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, const hb_tag_t *script_tags, unsigned int *script_index, hb_tag_t *chosen_script);
functions.description: Deprecated helper that scans an OpenType layout table (e.g., GSUB/GPOS) in the given face and selects the first available script from a zero-terminated preference-ordered list of script tags. On success, it reports the matched script index and/or the chosen script tag. Use hb_ot_layout_table_select_script instead.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t that contains the requested OpenType table.
table_tag must be a valid OpenType table tag applicable for script selection (typically GSUB/GPOS).
script_tags must point to a zero-terminated array of hb_tag_t values (the function relies on the terminator to know where to stop).
If script_index is non-null, it must point to writable memory to receive the selected script index.
If chosen_script is non-null, it must point to writable memory to receive the selected script tag.
Function returns an hb_bool_t indicating whether a script was found.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_script_find_language
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_script_find_language(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, hb_tag_t language_tag, unsigned int *language_index);
functions.description: Deprecated helper that looks up a language system within a specific script of an OpenType layout table (e.g., GSUB/GPOS). Given a script index and a language tag, it returns whether the language system exists and optionally provides its index. Use hb_ot_layout_script_select_language instead.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t that contains the requested OpenType table.
table_tag must be a valid OpenType table tag applicable for language lookup (typically GSUB/GPOS).
script_index must refer to a valid script within the specified table of the face.
language_tag must be a valid OpenType language system tag.
If language_index is non-null, it must point to writable memory to receive the language system index.
Function returns an hb_bool_t indicating whether the language system was found.

functions.name: hb_ot_tags_from_script
functions.description: Deprecated utility that maps a Unicode script (hb_script_t) to up to two OpenType script tags. Primary tag is written to script_tag_1; if an alternate tag exists, it is written to script_tag_2. Use hb_ot_tags_from_script_and_language instead.
requirements: script must be a valid hb_script_t value.
If script_tag_1 is non-null, it must point to writable memory for the primary OpenType script tag.
If script_tag_2 is non-null, it must point to writable memory for an alternate OpenType script tag (if any).
No return value; outputs are written via pointers.

functions.name: hb_ot_tag_from_language
functions.description: Deprecated utility that maps an hb_language_t to an OpenType language system tag and returns that tag. Use hb_ot_tags_from_script_and_language instead.
requirements: language must be a valid hb_language_t (as obtained from HarfBuzz APIs such as hb_language_from_string).
Returns an hb_tag_t representing the OpenType language system corresponding to the input language.

functions.name: hb_ot_var_get_axes
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_var_get_axes(hb_face_t *face, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *axes_count, hb_ot_var_axis_t *axes_array);
functions.description: Deprecated API that enumerates variation axes from a face’s fvar table into an array of hb_ot_var_axis_t entries, starting at start_offset. On return, axes_count contains the number of axes written (or possibly available), and axes_array receives axis records. Use hb_ot_var_get_axis_infos instead.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t with an OpenType variations (fvar) table.
start_offset specifies the starting axis record index; it should be within the range of available axes.
axes_count is IN/OUT: on input, it indicates the capacity of axes_array (in elements); on output, it is set to the number of axes written (or needed).
If axes_array is non-null, it must point to writable storage for at least *axes_count hb_ot_var_axis_t elements.
Return value is an unsigned int, typically the total number of axes available starting from start_offset (commonly used to size buffers).

functions.name: hb_ot_var_find_axis
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_ot_var_find_axis(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t axis_tag, unsigned int *axis_index, hb_ot_var_axis_t *axis_info);
functions.description: Deprecated API that finds a variation axis by tag in a face’s fvar table. On success, it can return the axis index and/or fill an hb_ot_var_axis_t with axis metadata. Use hb_ot_var_find_axis_info instead.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t with an OpenType variations (fvar) table.
axis_tag must be a valid axis tag present in the face (e.g., 'wght', 'wdth').
If axis_index is non-null, it must point to writable memory to receive the axis index.
If axis_info is non-null, it must point to writable memory to receive the axis information.
Function returns an hb_bool_t indicating whether the axis was found.

functions.name: hb_ot_font_set_funcs
functions.description: Assigns the OpenType-based font functions to the given HarfBuzz font object. Use this to configure an hb_font_t so that metrics, glyph advances, extents, and other callbacks are served by the font’s OpenType tables. Typical usage: call after creating an hb_font_t and before shaping or measuring text with that font. If other custom font funcs were previously set, this replaces them for subsequent operations.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t* (created via HarfBuzz font creation APIs).

font must not be immutable; calling this after hb_font_make_immutable() is not allowed and will have no effect or may fail depending on build (immutability is the usual requirement for mutating HarfBuzz objects).
Call before using the font for shaping/measurement if OpenType-provided metrics and callbacks are desired; it affects subsequent operations only.
Do not pass NULL; the function expects a non-null hb_font_t pointer.

functions.name: hb_ot_tags_from_script_and_language
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_tags_from_script_and_language(hb_script_t script, hb_language_t language, unsigned int *script_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *script_tags /* OUT */, unsigned int *language_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *language_tags /* OUT */);
functions.description: Maps a script and language to corresponding OpenType script and language tags. Fills provided arrays with up to the requested number of tags and updates the counts with the number written. Use to obtain font/OT tags for shaping selections.
requirements: script_count must point to the available capacity in script_tags on entry and will be updated with the number of tags written.
language_count must point to the available capacity in language_tags on entry and will be updated with the number of tags written.
If script_tags is provided, it must point to an array with at least *script_count elements.
If language_tags is provided, it must point to an array with at least *language_count elements.
script_count and language_count pointers must be valid (non-NULL) when their corresponding arrays are used.
script and language values should be valid hb_script_t and hb_language_t identifiers.

functions.name: hb_ot_tag_to_script
functions.description: Converts an OpenType script tag to the corresponding hb_script_t value. Use when interpreting OT tables or user-provided tags.
requirements: tag should be a valid 4-byte OpenType script tag.

functions.name: hb_ot_tag_to_language
functions.description: Converts an OpenType language tag to an hb_language_t. Useful for mapping OT language system tags to HarfBuzz language objects.
requirements: tag should be a valid 4-byte OpenType language tag (as used in OT tables).

functions.name: hb_ot_tags_to_script_and_language
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_tags_to_script_and_language(hb_tag_t script_tag, hb_tag_t language_tag, hb_script_t *script /* OUT */, hb_language_t *language /* OUT */);
functions.description: Converts OpenType script and language tags to hb_script_t and hb_language_t outputs. Use when reading tags from fonts and needing HarfBuzz script/language types.
requirements: script must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the mapped hb_script_t.
language must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the mapped hb_language_t.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_has_glyph_classes
functions.description: Returns whether the face’s GDEF table defines glyph classes. Use to check availability of GDEF class data before querying classes.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t created from a font.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_glyph_class
functions.description: Returns the GDEF glyph class for the specified glyph in the face. If no class is defined, HB_OT_LAYOUT_GLYPH_CLASS_UNCLASSIFIED is returned.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyph must be a glyph ID present in the face.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_glyphs_in_class
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_get_glyphs_in_class(hb_face_t *face, hb_ot_layout_glyph_class_t klass, hb_set_t *glyphs /* OUT */);
functions.description: Collects all glyph IDs in the specified GDEF class into the provided set.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyphs must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t to be populated.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_attach_points
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_get_attach_points(hb_face_t *face, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *point_count /* IN/OUT */, unsigned int *point_array /* OUT */);
functions.description: Retrieves attachment point indices for a glyph (from GDEF), starting at start_offset, writing up to point_count entries into point_array. Returns the total number of available points (or number written depending on implementation). Intended for clients caching attach points.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID in the face.
point_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number of points written.
point_array must point to an array with at least *point_count entries.
start_offset must not exceed the number of available attach points for the glyph (otherwise zero will be written).

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_ligature_carets
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_get_ligature_carets(hb_font_t *font, hb_direction_t direction, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *caret_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_position_t *caret_array /* OUT */);
functions.description: Retrieves caret positions for a ligature glyph, in the specified writing direction, starting at start_offset. Writes up to caret_count positions into caret_array and updates caret_count. Useful for text cursor placement within ligatures.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t configured for the face.
glyph must be a ligature glyph ID for meaningful results.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t indicating layout direction.
caret_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
caret_array must point to an array with at least *caret_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available number of caret positions.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_get_script_tags
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_table_get_script_tags(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *script_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *script_tags /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates script tags in the specified OT table (GSUB/GPOS/etc.), starting at start_offset. Writes up to script_count tags to script_tags and updates script_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be an OpenType layout table tag (e.g., HB_OT_TAG_GSUB, HB_OT_TAG_GPOS).
script_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
script_tags must point to an array with at least *script_count entries.
start_offset indicates the enumeration start index and must be within range.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_find_script
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_table_find_script(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, hb_tag_t script_tag, unsigned int *script_index /* OUT */);
functions.description: Searches for a script system by tag within the specified OT table and returns its index if found.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag (e.g., HB_OT_TAG_GSUB/GPOS).
script_tag must be a valid script tag.
script_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the index when found.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_select_script
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_table_select_script(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_count, const hb_tag_t *script_tags, unsigned int *script_index /* OUT */, hb_tag_t *chosen_script /* OUT */);
functions.description: Selects the first available script from a list of script tags in the specified table. Returns the index and which script was chosen.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_tags must point to an array of script_count tags.
script_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the index.
chosen_script must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the selected tag.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_get_feature_tags
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_table_get_feature_tags(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *feature_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *feature_tags /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates feature tags in the specified OT table, starting at start_offset. Writes up to feature_count tags and updates feature_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
feature_tags must point to an array with at least *feature_count entries.
start_offset must be within the range of available features.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_script_get_language_tags
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_script_get_language_tags(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *language_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *language_tags /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates language system tags under a given script in the specified OT table, starting at start_offset. Writes up to language_count tags and updates language_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index must be a valid script index within the table.
language_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
language_tags must point to an array with at least *language_count entries.
start_offset must be within the range of language systems.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_script_select_language
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_script_select_language(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_count, const hb_tag_t *language_tags, unsigned int *language_index /* OUT */);
functions.description: Selects the first available language system under a script from the provided list of language tags and returns its index.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index must reference an existing script in the table.
language_tags must point to an array of language_count tags.
language_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the result.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_script_select_language2
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_script_select_language2(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_count, const hb_tag_t *language_tags, unsigned int *language_index /* OUT */, hb_tag_t *chosen_language /* OUT */);
functions.description: Like hb_ot_layout_script_select_language, but also returns the chosen language tag.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index must reference an existing script in the table.
language_tags must point to an array of language_count tags.
language_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer.
chosen_language must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the tag.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_language_get_required_feature_index
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_language_get_required_feature_index(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_index, unsigned int *feature_index /* OUT */);
functions.description: Retrieves the index of the required feature for a language system, if any, in the specified table and script.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must refer to existing entries.
feature_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the index.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_language_get_required_feature
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_language_get_required_feature(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_index, unsigned int *feature_index /* OUT */, hb_tag_t *feature_tag /* OUT */);
functions.description: Retrieves both the index and tag of the required feature for a language system, if present.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must refer to existing entries.
feature_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer.
feature_tag must be a valid non-NULL pointer.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_indexes
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_indexes(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *feature_count /* IN/OUT */, unsigned int *feature_indexes /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates feature indexes under a script/language in the specified table, starting at start_offset. Writes up to feature_count indexes and updates feature_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must refer to existing entries.
feature_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
feature_indexes must point to an array with at least *feature_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available feature range.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_tags
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_tags(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *feature_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_tag_t *feature_tags /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates feature tags under a script/language in the specified table, starting at start_offset. Writes up to feature_count tags and updates feature_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must refer to existing entries.
feature_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
feature_tags must point to an array with at least *feature_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available feature range.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_language_find_feature
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_language_find_feature(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int script_index, unsigned int language_index, hb_tag_t feature_tag, unsigned int *feature_index /* OUT */);
functions.description: Finds a feature by tag within a specific script/language of an OT table and returns its index.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must refer to existing entries.
feature_tag must be a valid tag to search for.
feature_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the index.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_feature_get_lookups
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_feature_get_lookups(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int feature_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *lookup_count /* IN/OUT */, unsigned int *lookup_indexes /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates lookup indexes associated with a feature in an OT table, starting at start_offset. Writes up to lookup_count entries and updates lookup_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_index must refer to an existing feature in the table.
lookup_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
lookup_indexes must point to an array with at least *lookup_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available lookups for the feature.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_get_lookup_count
functions.description: Returns the number of lookups in the specified OT table.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_collect_features
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_collect_features(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, const hb_tag_t *scripts, const hb_tag_t *languages, const hb_tag_t *features, hb_set_t *feature_indexes /* OUT */);
functions.description: Collects feature indexes from the specified table that match the provided script/language/feature filters, and adds them to feature_indexes. Useful for precomputing sets of features to apply.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_indexes must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t to receive results.
scripts, languages, and features must point to valid arrays if provided (details of termination or counts are not specified in this header).

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_collect_features_map
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_collect_features_map(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned script_index, unsigned language_index, hb_map_t *feature_map /* OUT */);
functions.description: Collects features for a specific script/language in the given table and stores them in feature_map, mapping feature tags or indexes per implementation. Intended for bulk feature discovery.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
script_index and language_index must be valid for the table.
feature_map must be a valid non-NULL hb_map_t to be populated.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_collect_lookups
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_collect_lookups(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, const hb_tag_t *scripts, const hb_tag_t *languages, const hb_tag_t *features, hb_set_t *lookup_indexes /* OUT */);
functions.description: Collects lookup indexes from the specified table that match the provided script/language/feature filters, adding them to lookup_indexes.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
lookup_indexes must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t to receive results.
scripts, languages, and features must point to valid arrays if provided (details of termination or counts are not specified in this header).

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_collect_glyphs
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_lookup_collect_glyphs(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int lookup_index, hb_set_t *glyphs_before, /* OUT.  May be NULL */ hb_set_t *glyphs_input,  /* OUT.  May be NULL */ hb_set_t *glyphs_after,  /* OUT.  May be NULL */ hb_set_t *glyphs_output  /* OUT.  May be NULL */);
functions.description: Collects glyphs referenced by a specific lookup, partitioned into before/input/after/output sets. Any of the output sets may be NULL to skip collection for that category.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
lookup_index must be a valid lookup index within the table.
Each non-NULL hb_set_t output must be a valid set to be populated.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_table_find_feature_variations
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_table_find_feature_variations(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, const int *coords, unsigned int num_coords, unsigned int *variations_index /* out */);
functions.description: Finds the applicable FeatureVariations record in the specified table for the given variation coordinates, returning its index if found.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag supporting FeatureVariations (e.g., GSUB/GPOS).
coords must point to an array of num_coords design-space coordinates (integers).
variations_index must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the index.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_feature_with_variations_get_lookups
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_feature_with_variations_get_lookups(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int feature_index, unsigned int variations_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *lookup_count /* IN/OUT */, unsigned int *lookup_indexes /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates lookup indexes for a feature taking a specific FeatureVariations record into account, starting at start_offset. Writes up to lookup_count entries and updates lookup_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_index must be a valid feature index within the table.
variations_index must be a valid FeatureVariations index (or HB_OT_LAYOUT_NO_VARIATIONS_INDEX if applicable by implementation).
lookup_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
lookup_indexes must point to an array with at least *lookup_count entries.
start_offset must be within the range of applicable lookups.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_has_substitution
functions.description: Returns whether the face provides GSUB substitutions. Use to check for substitution capabilities before applying GSUB lookups.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_get_glyph_alternates
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned hb_ot_layout_lookup_get_glyph_alternates(hb_face_t *face, unsigned lookup_index, hb_codepoint_t glyph, unsigned start_offset, unsigned *alternate_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_codepoint_t *alternate_glyphs /* OUT */);
functions.description: Enumerates alternate glyphs produced by a specific lookup for a given glyph, starting at start_offset. Writes up to alternate_count alternates and updates alternate_count.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
lookup_index must be a valid GSUB lookup index.
glyph must be a valid input glyph ID for the lookup.
alternate_count must be a valid pointer specifying capacity on input; updated with number written.
alternate_glyphs must point to an array with at least *alternate_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available alternates for the glyph.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_collect_glyph_alternates
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_lookup_collect_glyph_alternates(hb_face_t *face, unsigned lookup_index, hb_map_t *alternate_count /* IN/OUT */, hb_map_t *alternate_glyphs /* IN/OUT */);
functions.description: Collects alternate glyph information for a lookup across glyphs into maps, e.g., mapping each glyph to its number of alternates and to alternate glyph IDs. Returns true on success.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
lookup_index must be a valid GSUB lookup index.
alternate_count must be a valid hb_map_t for counts (will be updated).
alternate_glyphs must be a valid hb_map_t for glyph lists (will be updated).

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_would_substitute
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_lookup_would_substitute(hb_face_t *face, unsigned int lookup_index, const hb_codepoint_t *glyphs, unsigned int glyphs_length, hb_bool_t zero_context);
functions.description: Tests whether a lookup would substitute the given glyph sequence. Does not perform the substitution. Useful for fallback decisions or preflight checks.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
lookup_index must be a valid lookup index.
glyphs must point to an array of glyphs of length glyphs_length.
glyphs_length must correctly reflect the number of glyphs provided.
zero_context controls whether context is ignored; pass HB_TRUE/HB_FALSE as needed.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_substitute_closure
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_lookup_substitute_closure(hb_face_t *face, unsigned int lookup_index, hb_set_t *glyphs);
functions.description: Computes the transitive closure of glyphs reachable by substitutions from the given lookup, adding them to the provided glyph set. Useful for preloading or subsetting.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
lookup_index must be a valid GSUB lookup index.
glyphs must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t; it will be read and augmented with additional glyphs.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookups_substitute_closure
functions.description: Like hb_ot_layout_lookup_substitute_closure but processes a set of lookups, adding all glyphs reachable by their substitutions into glyphs.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
lookups must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t containing lookup indexes.
glyphs must be a valid non-NULL hb_set_t to be augmented.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_has_positioning
functions.description: Returns whether the face provides GPOS positioning data. Use to check for positioning capabilities before applying GPOS lookups.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_size_params
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_get_size_params(hb_face_t *face, unsigned int *design_size,       /* OUT.  May be NULL */ unsigned int *subfamily_id,      /* OUT.  May be NULL */ hb_ot_name_id_t *subfamily_name_id, /* OUT.  May be NULL */ unsigned int *range_start,       /* OUT.  May be NULL */ unsigned int *range_end          /* OUT.  May be NULL */);
functions.description: Retrieves optical ‘size’ feature parameters from the face if present. Returns true if found. Any of the output parameters may be NULL to ignore that value.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
Each non-NULL output pointer must be valid for writing.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_lookup_get_optical_bound
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_position_t hb_ot_layout_lookup_get_optical_bound(hb_font_t *font, unsigned lookup_index, hb_direction_t direction, hb_codepoint_t glyph);
functions.description: Returns the optical bound (position offset) for a glyph as defined by a specific lookup and direction. Used for optical margin/bounds calculations.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
lookup_index must be a valid lookup index relevant to optical bounds.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
glyph must be a valid glyph ID.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_feature_get_name_ids
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_feature_get_name_ids(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int feature_index, hb_ot_name_id_t *label_id             /* OUT.  May be NULL */, hb_ot_name_id_t *tooltip_id           /* OUT.  May be NULL */, hb_ot_name_id_t *sample_id            /* OUT.  May be NULL */, unsigned int *num_named_parameters /* OUT.  May be NULL */, hb_ot_name_id_t *first_param_id       /* OUT.  May be NULL */);
functions.description: Retrieves name IDs and metadata for a feature (label, tooltip, sample text, parameter info). Returns true if available. Any output parameter may be NULL if not needed.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_index must refer to an existing feature.
Each non-NULL output pointer must be valid for writing.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_feature_get_characters
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN unsigned int hb_ot_layout_feature_get_characters(hb_face_t *face, hb_tag_t table_tag, unsigned int feature_index, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *char_count    /* IN/OUT.  May be NULL */, hb_codepoint_t *characters    /* OUT.     May be NULL */);
functions.description: Enumerates Unicode characters associated with a feature, starting at start_offset. Writes up to char_count entries to characters and updates char_count. Either or both output pointers may be NULL to query sizes or skip data.
requirements: face must be a valid hb_face_t.
table_tag must be a valid OT table tag.
feature_index must refer to an existing feature.
If char_count is non-NULL and characters is provided, characters must have capacity for at least *char_count entries.
start_offset must be within the available character list.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_font_extents
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_get_font_extents(hb_font_t *font, hb_direction_t direction, hb_tag_t script_tag, hb_tag_t language_tag, hb_font_extents_t *extents);
functions.description: Retrieves font extents from BASE/metrics for a given direction and script/language tags. Returns true if available.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script_tag and language_tag should be valid OT tags.
extents must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive results.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_font_extents2
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_get_font_extents2(hb_font_t *font, hb_direction_t direction, hb_script_t script, hb_language_t language, hb_font_extents_t *extents);
functions.description: Like hb_ot_layout_get_font_extents but takes hb_script_t and hb_language_t instead of OT tags. Returns true if extents are available.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script and language must be valid identifiers.
extents must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive results.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_horizontal_baseline_tag_for_script
functions.description: Returns the default horizontal baseline tag appropriate for the given script (e.g., roman, hanging, ideographic).
requirements: script must be a valid hb_script_t.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_baseline
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_get_baseline(hb_font_t *font, hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t baseline_tag, hb_direction_t direction, hb_tag_t script_tag, hb_tag_t language_tag, hb_position_t *coord        /* OUT.  May be NULL. */);
functions.description: Retrieves a baseline coordinate for the specified baseline tag, direction, and script/language tags. Returns true if baseline is found. coord may be NULL to query existence only.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
baseline_tag must be a valid hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script_tag and language_tag should be valid OT tags.
If coord is non-NULL, it must be valid for writing.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_baseline2
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN hb_bool_t hb_ot_layout_get_baseline2(hb_font_t *font, hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t baseline_tag, hb_direction_t direction, hb_script_t script, hb_language_t language, hb_position_t *coord        /* OUT.  May be NULL. */);
functions.description: Like hb_ot_layout_get_baseline but takes hb_script_t and hb_language_t instead of OT tags. Returns true if baseline is found. coord may be NULL to query existence only.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
baseline_tag must be a valid hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script and language must be valid identifiers.
If coord is non-NULL, it must be valid for writing.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_baseline_with_fallback
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_get_baseline_with_fallback(hb_font_t *font, hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t baseline_tag, hb_direction_t direction, hb_tag_t script_tag, hb_tag_t language_tag, hb_position_t *coord        /* OUT */);
functions.description: Retrieves a baseline coordinate for the specified parameters, using fallbacks when explicit data is not available. Always writes a coordinate.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
baseline_tag must be a valid hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script_tag and language_tag should be valid OT tags.
coord must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the baseline coordinate.

functions.name: hb_ot_layout_get_baseline_with_fallback2
functions.signature: HB_EXTERN void hb_ot_layout_get_baseline_with_fallback2(hb_font_t *font, hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t baseline_tag, hb_direction_t direction, hb_script_t script, hb_language_t language, hb_position_t *coord        /* OUT */);
functions.description: Like hb_ot_layout_get_baseline_with_fallback but takes hb_script_t and hb_language_t. Always writes a coordinate using fallbacks if needed.
requirements: font must be a valid hb_font_t.
baseline_tag must be a valid hb_ot_layout_baseline_tag_t.
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t.
script and language must be valid identifiers.
coord must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the baseline coordinate.

functions.name: hb_ot_math_has_data
functions.description: Returns whether the given face has OpenType MATH table data. Use this to gate calls to other MATH accessors.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t pointer
Callers must handle the false case (no MATH data present) before using other MATH APIs

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_constant
functions.description: Fetches a numeric MATH table constant from the font (eg, axis height, rule thickness). Intended for layout engines implementing mathematical typesetting.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
constant must be a valid hb_ot_math_constant_t value
Callers must handle fonts without MATH data (result may be zero or a fallback)
The returned value is a position value; exact units/scaling follow hb_position_t conventions (inferred: hb_font_t scaling applies)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_italics_correction
functions.description: Returns the glyph-specific italics correction from the MATH table, used to adjust placement of superscripts/attachments for italic shapes.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
Callers must handle fonts or glyphs without MATH italics data (result may be zero)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_top_accent_attachment
functions.description: Returns the top accent attachment position for the given glyph from the MATH table, used to center or place accents on large operators and symbols.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
Callers must handle the absence of MATH data for the glyph (result may be zero)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_is_glyph_extended_shape
functions.description: Reports whether the glyph is classified as an Extended Shape per the MATH table’s ExtendedShapeCoverage (affects spacing and building of stretchables).
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t for the face
Callers must handle the false case (either not covered or no MATH data)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kerning
functions.signature: hb_position_t hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kerning (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_ot_math_kern_t kern, hb_position_t correction_height);
functions.description: Returns the math cut-in (kerning) value for the specified glyph corner at the provided correction height, used to adjust spacing between adjacent tall glyphs (e.g., delimiters).
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
kern must be one of hb_ot_math_kern_t values (TOP_RIGHT, TOP_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT)
correction_height is a position value in the same units as hb_position_t; callers must choose an appropriate height for the context
Callers must handle fonts without MATH kerning data (result may be zero)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kernings
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kernings (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_ot_math_kern_t kern, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *entries_count, hb_ot_math_kern_entry_t *kern_entries);
functions.description: Retrieves a sequence of math kerning (cut-in) entries for the given glyph corner, starting at start_offset. Use to enumerate correction-height breakpoints and their kern values.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
kern must be a valid hb_ot_math_kern_t value
entries_count must be a non-null pointer; on input it specifies the capacity of kern_entries (number of elements), on output it may be updated to the number of elements actually written
kern_entries must point to writable storage for at least *entries_count hb_ot_math_kern_entry_t elements, or may be NULL to query the total available entries
start_offset must be within the range of available entries; if it exceeds the available entries, zero items will be written
The function returns the number of entries written starting at start_offset; callers should typically first call with kern_entries == NULL (or capacity 0) to learn the total size and then allocate
Callers must handle the case where no MATH data is present (zero count)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_variants
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_math_get_glyph_variants (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *variants_count, hb_ot_math_glyph_variant_t *variants);
functions.description: Enumerates size variants of a glyph for the specified direction (horizontal or vertical stretch), returning glyph IDs and advances from the MATH table.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t indicating the stretch axis (inferred typical: HB_DIRECTION_LTR for horizontal, HB_DIRECTION_TTB for vertical)
variants_count must be non-null; on input it is the capacity of variants, on output it may be updated to the number actually written
variants must point to writable storage for at least *variants_count hb_ot_math_glyph_variant_t elements, or may be NULL to query the total available variants
start_offset must be within the range of available variants; if it exceeds the available variants, zero items will be written
The function returns the number of variants written starting at start_offset; callers commonly first query the total then allocate
Callers must handle the case where no variants exist or no MATH data is present (zero count)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_min_connector_overlap
functions.description: Returns the minimal connector overlap required when assembling stretchable glyphs in the given direction, as specified by the MATH table.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t
Callers must handle fonts without MATH data (result may be zero)

functions.name: hb_ot_math_get_glyph_assembly
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_math_get_glyph_assembly (hb_font_t *font, hb_codepoint_t glyph, hb_direction_t direction, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *parts_count, hb_ot_math_glyph_part_t *parts, hb_position_t *italics_correction);
functions.description: Retrieves the parts used to assemble a stretchable version of the glyph in the specified direction, along with the associated italics correction if provided by the MATH table.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer
glyph must be a valid hb_codepoint_t present in the font
direction must be a valid hb_direction_t
parts_count must be non-null; on input it is the capacity of parts, on output it may be updated to the number of parts written
parts must point to writable storage for at least *parts_count hb_ot_math_glyph_part_t elements, or may be NULL to query the total available parts
italics_correction must point to writable hb_position_t if provided; callers may pass NULL if they do not need the italics correction (inferred)
start_offset must be within the range of available parts; if it exceeds the available parts, zero items will be written
The function returns the number of parts written starting at start_offset; callers typically first query the total then allocate
Callers must handle the case where no assembly exists or no MATH data is present (zero count, italics correction possibly zero)

functions.name: hb_ot_meta_get_entry_tags
functions.signature: unsigned int hb_ot_meta_get_entry_tags(hb_face_t *face, unsigned int start_offset, unsigned int *entries_count /* IN/OUT.  May be NULL. */, hb_ot_meta_tag_t *entries /* OUT.  May be NULL. */);
functions.description: Enumerate META table entry tags present in the given face. Starting at start_offset, writes up to *entries_count tags into entries and sets *entries_count to the number of tags written. Returns the total number of META entry tags available in the face regardless of start_offset (pattern inferred from HarfBuzz tag enumeration APIs). Use this to page through tags by calling repeatedly with increasing start_offset. If entries or entries_count is NULL, the function can be used to query the total count without retrieving tags.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t.
entries_count may be NULL (explicit).
entries may be NULL (explicit).

If entries is non-NULL, entries_count (when non-NULL) must contain the capacity (number of elements) available at entries on input; on return it is updated to the number of tags written (inferred from HarfBuzz enumeration conventions).
start_offset is the index of the first tag to retrieve; if start_offset is beyond the end, no tags are written (inferred).
The function returns the total number of META entry tags present in the face (inferred from naming/usage of similar HarfBuzz functions).

functions.name: hb_ot_meta_reference_entry
functions.description: Return a blob referencing the data of the META table entry identified by meta_tag in the given face. Intended to let callers access the raw entry payload for tags such as HB_OT_META_TAG_DESIGN_LANGUAGES or HB_OT_META_TAG_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES. The returned blob follows HarfBuzz reference semantics (typically a ref-counted hb_blob_t); if the entry is absent, an empty blob may be returned rather than NULL (inferred from HarfBuzz “reference_*” API pattern). Caller is responsible for releasing the blob when done.
requirements: face must be a valid, initialized hb_face_t.
meta_tag should be a valid hb_ot_meta_tag_t value (e.g., HB_OT_META_TAG_DESIGN_LANGUAGES or HB_OT_META_TAG_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES).
Caller must release the returned hb_blob_t when finished (e.g., via hb_blob_destroy), per HarfBuzz blob ownership conventions (inferred).
If the specified entry does not exist, expect an empty blob rather than a NULL pointer (inferred).

functions.name: hb_ot_metrics_get_position
functions.signature: hb_bool_t hb_ot_metrics_get_position(hb_font_t *font, hb_ot_metrics_tag_t metrics_tag, hb_position_t *position /* OUT. May be NULL. */);
functions.description: Query an OpenType metric value from the font for the specified metrics_tag. On success, writes the metric into position (scaled in the font’s hb_position_t units) and returns true; if the metric is unavailable, returns false and position is left unspecified. Use when you want the raw presence/absence of a specific OT metric without synthesized fallbacks.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer; must not be NULL.
metrics_tag must be a valid hb_ot_metrics_tag_t value (one of the defined tags).
If position is non-NULL, it must point to writable storage for one hb_position_t.
Caller must check the returned hb_bool_t to determine success before using the value in position.
Returned value is in the font’s hb_position_t units as configured on the hb_font_t (scaling/variations applied as per font configuration).

functions.name: hb_ot_metrics_get_position_with_fallback
functions.description: Retrieve an OpenType metric value for metrics_tag, writing the result to position. If the specific OT metric is missing, a reasonable fallback/synthesized value is provided. Use when you always need a usable metric even if the font lacks an explicit value.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer; must not be NULL.
metrics_tag must be a valid hb_ot_metrics_tag_t value (one of the defined tags).
position must be non-NULL and point to writable storage for one hb_position_t.
Result is provided in the font’s hb_position_t units as configured on the hb_font_t (scaling/variations applied as per font configuration).
Function does not return a status; caller should assume position is written with either a real or synthesized value.

functions.name: hb_ot_metrics_get_variation
functions.description: Return the variation delta (adjustment) for the specified metric at the font’s current variation coordinates. This is the amount contributed by variation data (e.g., MVAR) for metrics_tag. Returns 0 when no variation applies. Useful for tooling or when combining a base metric with its variation delta manually.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer; must not be NULL.
metrics_tag must be a valid hb_ot_metrics_tag_t value.
The returned value is a floating-point delta in the same conceptual units as the metric (aligned with the font’s configuration).

functions.name: hb_ot_metrics_get_x_variation
functions.description: Return the x-axis variation delta for the specified metric at the font’s current variation coordinates, in hb_position_t units. Returns 0 when no variation applies. Intended for integer-position workflows where x-direction adjustments are needed.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer; must not be NULL.
metrics_tag must be a valid hb_ot_metrics_tag_t value.
Returned value is an hb_position_t delta consistent with the font’s scaling configuration.

functions.name: hb_ot_metrics_get_y_variation
functions.description: Return the y-axis variation delta for the specified metric at the font’s current variation coordinates, in hb_position_t units. Returns 0 when no variation applies. Intended for integer-position workflows where y-direction adjustments are needed.
requirements: font must be a valid, initialized hb_font_t pointer; must not be NULL.
metrics_tag must be a valid hb_ot_metrics_tag_t value.
Returned value is an hb_position_t delta consistent with the font’s scaling configuration.

functions.name: hb_ot_name_list_names
